basis: at least five causally coupled subsystems: steering geometry, wheel rotation, tyre slip/friction, load/force coupling, and three-axis body dynamics
nonlinear combined-slip tyre dynamics and dynamic rear-wheel actuation
three independently effective intervention axes: steering, symmetric rear torque, and differential rear torque
six private conditions spanning dynamic, steady/terminal, symmetry, and robustness targets

A.meaning: vehicle velocity, acceleration, yaw-rate, and yaw-acceleration trajectory accuracy

Q.meaning: finite complete logs with exact public widths, units, order, and five-second coverage

M.meaning: wheel-slip, tyre-force, wheel-actuation, and coupled body-dynamics mechanism fidelity

C.meaning: open-loop steering, symmetric-torque, and differential-torque causal intervention fidelity

R.meaning: worst private-condition handling and numerical robustness

D.meaning: startup, transient shape, and terminal dynamic fidelity

score_policy.within_group: task-specific weighted arithmetic aggregation with explicit worst-condition retention
score_policy.across_groups: weighted geometric mean; absent critical mechanism groups may be zero

minimum_shortcut_sanity_contract: one scenario replayed for every intervention
command channels copied as physical-state outputs
